title: BIRD
bigQuestion: How do feathers help a bird?
paragraphs: Bird feathers have different shapes because they do different jobs. Soft down feathers trap air, so a bird stays warm. Long wing feathers push air down and help make lift. Tail feathers spread and turn, so the bird can steer.
